# SB-1017 Safety bulletin: airborne dust from blasting

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Hazard description
Blasting operations adjacent to the Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill produce airborne dust containing ferrous particulate and spent abrasive. Dust becomes entrained in cross drafts and may accumulate on equipment surfaces, electrical enclosures, and breathing zones. Fine particulate increases the risk of respiratory irritation, reduced visibility at the workface, and can contribute to premature wear of bearings and seals if it migrates into mechanical assemblies. The risk is elevated during setup, mandrel changes, and local grinding where containment is incomplete.

Affected equipment
This bulletin applies to EQ-P2-L2-RR03 and to plant areas immediately surrounding the blast cabinet and material handling path on P2-L2. Operators, maintenance technicians, and blasting personnel working within the immediate work envelope must follow the controls below. Refer to MM-P2-L2-RR03 for maintenance-specific procedures and SOP-P2-L2-03 for standard operating steps related to ring handling and changeover.

Required controls
- Implement engineering controls: install localized extraction at the blast source and ensure directional airflow away from the RR03 control station. Clean dust collection receptacles prior to any mandrel work to prevent re-entrainment.  
- Administrative controls: restrict nonessential personnel during blasting and setup; document blasting periods in the craft log; incorporate SB-1049 controls for personal protective equipment selection and fit verification.  
- Personal protective equipment: require NIOSH-approved respiratory protection where extraction is not sufficient, protective eyewear, and disposable coveralls for personnel conducting cleanup.  
- Mechanical safeguards: before mandrel work, verify clamp condition and function per MM-P2-L2-RR03. The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 620 N·m. Record torque verification in the maintenance entry.  
- Housekeeping: schedule focused vacuum cleaning of the RR03 area after blasting and prior to mandrel disassembly to prevent dust ingress into the drive and bearing housings.

Effective date
Effective immediately.
